title: Ruins of Aboraz
wikitext:
[[Image:Ruins of Aboraz.jpg|thumb|300px|Ruins of Aboraz]]
The '''Ruins of Aboraz''' is a collection of ancient [[troll]] ruins on the southeastern coast of [[Stranglethorn Vale]], now the home of the witch doctor [[Zanzil the Outcast]].  Zanzil's ghoul, naga, and troll minions wander the ruins, and the captured Darkspear troll [[Yenniku]] is also here as a thrall of Zanzil. The bewitched debtor to [["Sea Wolf" MacKinley]], [[Chucky "Ten Thumbs"]], also roams the ruins as a ghoul.

It is located southeast of [[Ruins of Jubuwal]], east of [[Spirit Den]], and south of [[Crystalvein Mine]].
